name: Home for Visually Challenged Person
benefit:
1. Free Food and Shelter.
1. Free Supply of Daily Living Needs.
1. Pocket Money of ₹ 5/-.
1. Vocational Training Such as Korai & Coir Mat Weaving, According to Their Interest. 
1. Labour Charges of ₹ 20 /- for Mat.
1. Recreations Such as TV, Radio, Musical Instrument, Besides Local Trips to Places of Interest and Temples. 
1. Annual Tour to Places of Interest. 

**NOTE:** Contact the authoriti
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should have a total absence of sight. 1. The applicant should have a visual acuity not exceeding 6/60 or 20/200 in the better eye with correcting lenses. 1. The applicant should have a limitation of field of vision sub standing an angle of 20 degree. 1. The applicant should be above 20 years of age.
